Method of Attack: Remote VNC, Remote Shell, File Explorer, Process Manager, Remote Webcam, Password Manager, Reverse Socks, Download & Execute a file, Remote Keylogger, HRDP Manager as well as Privilege Escalation.

Steals credentials from browsers and email clients, supports control commands to control the victim’s device such as starting a process, capturing the screenshot, manipulating the victim’s mouse and keyboard.
Provides information collection like clipboard logger, keylogger, application credentials, Webcam logging, Voice Recording. Supports wide control commands for controlling the victim’s device.
Attack Vector: Phishing campaign that delivers fileless malware via a newly-created 'aspnet_compiler.exe' process.
Phishing campaign that injects fileless malware into the 'RegAsm.exe' process.
